title: CAPIT Terms of Use
description: Review the terms that govern your use of the CAPIT website, its data views, and any wallet-enabled features on the Base network.
headline: Terms of Use
body: Last updated: [Month DD, YYYY]. These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of CAPIT and any related websites, content, data views, applications, and wallet-enabled features provided by [Legal Entity Name]. By using CAPIT, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: Using CAPIT
sections.body: You may use CAPIT only in compliance with these Terms and applicable law. CAPIT may modify, suspend, or discontinue features at any time.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: You represent that you have the legal capacity to use CAPIT and, where required, are old enough to enter a binding agreement in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: No Advice and No Financial Returns
sections.body: CAPIT provides informational content and software interfaces exclusively. Nothing on CAPIT constitutes financial, investment, legal, tax, environmental, engineering, or regulatory advice. CAPIT tokens are non-inflationary environmental infrastructure receipts, not speculative instruments.

sections.heading: Wallets and Blockchain Transactions
sections.body: Wallet connections, approvals, token swaps, and other on-chain actions on the Base network involve third-party protocols, public networks, fees, and irreversible outcomes. CAPIT does not control third-party wallets and cannot reverse completed blockchain transactions.

sections.heading: Data Availability
sections.body: CAPIT relies on public records and third-party state registry systems that may be delayed, incomplete, changed, or unavailable. CAPIT may display revisions, corrections, and partial coverage based on these public sources.

sections.heading: No Warranty and No Guarantees
sections.body: CAPIT is provided as is and as available, without warranties of any kind to the extent permitted by law. CAPIT explicitly does not guarantee uninterrupted availability, error-free content, profitability, environmental outcomes, or the regulatory treatment of any token as a carbon offset or environmental credit.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, [Legal Entity Name] and its affiliates will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages, or for lost profits, loss of data, or trading losses related to your use of CAPIT.
